prompt: In this CAP project, add a Reviews entity with a rating (1-5) and a comment, give it a managed association to Books, and expose it read-only in the catalog service. Use CAP conventions.

assertions.cmd: cds compile srv --to csn | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const m=JSON.parse(s);const r=Object.keys(m.definitions).find(k=>/Reviews$/.test(k));if(!r)process.exit(1);const e=m.definitions[r];const hasAssoc=Object.values(e.elements||{}).some(el=>el.type==='cds.Association'||el.target);process.exit(hasAssoc?0:1)})"
